rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, lr=0.0001, epochs=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). ONE KNOB: epochs 8 -> 20 (everything else identical to iter-1: unet_c=16, lr=1e-4, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, seed=42). FAILURE MODE OBSERVED: iter-1 (SSIM 0.887976 / hr 0.275953, the campaign headroom LEADER) used only elapsed_s=418.58s (~7.0 min) of the HARD 20-min train+score budget -- i.e. ~35%% utilised, ~13 min of headroom UNSPENT. DD-UNet has no unrolled DC loop so it is cheap per step; at 8 epochs the supervised dual-domain U-Net is almost certainly UNDER-TRAINED at this budget (mirrors itnet_v3, which at iter-1 used only 12.3/20 min and whose lever was epochs-up; the discarded boundary-slice run also hinted epochs as the dominant lever for this solver). HYPOTHESIS: if I raise epochs 8->20 (everything else fixed), I expect val_ssim and headroom to RISE above the iter-1 baseline (hr>0.276), because the model is under-converged at 8 epochs and 2.5x more gradient steps will reduce the train MSE further without overfitting the L277 val (214-slice metric averages out per-slice noise). FALSIFIER: if hr does NOT exceed 0.276 (or DROPS) at epochs=20, the solver was already near its 8-epoch convergence basin -> epochs is NOT the lever and iter-3 should move to lambda_neg (1.0->0.1, discarded-run hint) or lr. BUDGET CHECK vs iter-1 measured time: iter-1 = 418.58s for 8 epochs + 214-slice per-sample val + figure. Decompose ~140s fixed (data load + per-sample 214-slice val + figure I/O) + ~278s for 8 epochs (~35s/epoch). At epochs=20: ~140 + 20*35 = ~840s (~14 min) train+score; pessimistic (150s fixed + 40s/epoch) = ~950s (~15.8 min). BOTH inside the 20-min (1200s) train+score budget and the 30-min sbatch wall. grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients ~18x -> lr is kept conservative + nonfinite-grad-skip). val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (NOT reduced). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample pipe.R_full swap, bg_target=truth, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override).
